t: 瑞典摄政王斯滕·斯图尔(Sten Sture the Younger)在博热松德战役中受了致命…
te: Sten Sture the Younger, the Regent of Sweden, is mortally wounded at the Battle of Bogesund and dies on February 3.
dz: 瑞典摄政王斯滕·斯图尔(Sten Sture the Younger)在博热松德战役中受了致命伤并死于2月3日.
de: Sten Sture the Younger, the Regent of Sweden, is mortally wounded at the Battle of Bogesund and dies on February 3.

t: 公社的革命从西班牙开始,反对查理五世的统治.
te: The Revolt of the Comuneros begins in Spain against the rule of Charles V.
dz: 公社的革命从西班牙开始,反对查理五世的统治.
de: The Revolt of the Comuneros begins in Spain against the rule of Charles V.

t: 赫尔南·科尔特斯击败了被西班牙派去惩罚他不服从命令的潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦斯.
te: Hernan Cortés defeats Pánfilo de Narváez, sent by Spain to punish him for insubordination.
dz: 赫尔南·科尔特斯击败了被西班牙派去惩罚他不服从命令的潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦斯.
de: Hernan Cortés defeats Pánfilo de Narváez, sent by Spain to punish him for insubordination.

t: Tóxcatl节的屠杀发生在特诺克蒂特兰的倒下,导致阿兹特克人与西班牙人对立.
te: The massacre at the festival of Tóxcatl takes place during the Fall of Tenochtitlan, resulting in turning the Aztecs ag…
dz: Tóxcatl节的屠杀发生在特诺克蒂特兰的倒下,导致阿兹特克人与西班牙人对立.
de: The massacre at the festival of Tóxcatl takes place during the Fall of Tenochtitlan, resulting in turning the Aztecs against the Spanish.

t: 教皇利奥十世在 Exsurge Domine 中威胁要将马丁·路德逐出教会。
te: Pope Leo X threatens to excommunicate Martin Luther in Exsurge Domine.
dz: 教皇利奥十世在 Exsurge Domine 中威胁要将马丁·路德逐出教会。
de: Pope Leo X threatens to excommunicate Martin Luther in Exsurge Domine.

t: 克洛斯地(英语:The Field of the Cloth of Gold)是英国的亨利八世…
te: The Field of the Cloth of Gold, a summit meeting between Henry VIII of England and Francis I of France, ends.
dz: 克洛斯地(英语:The Field of the Cloth of Gold)是英国的亨利八世和法国的弗朗西斯一世的一次峰会,会后结束.
de: The Field of the Cloth of Gold, a summit meeting between Henry VIII of England and Francis I of France, ends.

t: 由埃尔南·科尔特斯率领的西班牙征服者在天黑后出征特诺克蒂特兰.
te: Spanish conquistadors led by Hernán Cortés fight their way out of Tenochtitlan after nightfall.
dz: 由埃尔南·科尔特斯率领的西班牙征服者在天黑后出征特诺克蒂特兰.
de: Spanish conquistadors led by Hernán Cortés fight their way out of Tenochtitlan after nightfall.

t: 西班牙征服者在奥通巴战役中击败了一支更大的阿兹特克军队.
te: Spanish conquistadores defeat a larger Aztec army at the Battle of Otumba.
dz: 西班牙征服者在奥通巴战役中击败了一支更大的阿兹特克军队.
de: Spanish conquistadores defeat a larger Aztec army at the Battle of Otumba.

t: 伟大的苏莱曼成为奥斯曼帝国的苏丹.
te: Suleiman the Magnificent becomes sultan of the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 伟大的苏莱曼成为奥斯曼帝国的苏丹.
de: Suleiman the Magnificent becomes sultan of the Ottoman Empire.

t: 若昂·阿尔瓦雷斯·法贡德斯发现了圣皮埃尔岛和密克龙岛,赋予了它们"11000名圣母的岛屿"的原…
te: João Álvares Fagundes discovers the islands of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, bestowing on them their original name of "Isl…
dz: 若昂·阿尔瓦雷斯·法贡德斯发现了圣皮埃尔岛和密克龙岛,赋予了它们"11000名圣母的岛屿"的原名.
de: João Álvares Fagundes discovers the islands of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, bestowing on them their original name of "Islands of the 11,000 Virgins".

t: 查理五世被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
te: Charles V is crowned as Holy Roman Emperor.
dz: 查理五世被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
de: Charles V is crowned as Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 费迪南德·麦哲伦到达太平洋。
te: Ferdinand Magellan reaches the Pacific Ocean.
dz: 费迪南德·麦哲伦到达太平洋。
de: Ferdinand Magellan reaches the Pacific Ocean.

t: 麦哲伦海峡是紧接南美洲大陆以南连接太平洋和大西洋的通道,最早由欧洲探险家斐迪南·麦哲伦在第一次…
te: The Strait of Magellan, the passage immediately south of mainland South America connecting the Pacific and the Atlantic…
dz: 麦哲伦海峡是紧接南美洲大陆以南连接太平洋和大西洋的通道,最早由欧洲探险家斐迪南·麦哲伦在第一次有记录的环航航行中发现并航行.
de: The Strait of Magellan, the passage immediately south of mainland South America connecting the Pacific and the Atlantic Oceans, is first discovered and navigated by European explorer Ferdinand Magellan during the first recorded circumnavigation voyage.

t: 加冕为瑞典国王后，克里斯蒂安二世不顾大赦的承诺，下令处决近 100 人，其中大部分是贵族。
te: After being crowned king of Sweden, Christian II gave the order to execute nearly 100 people, mostly noblemen, despite …
dz: 加冕为瑞典国王后，克里斯蒂安二世不顾大赦的承诺，下令处决近 100 人，其中大部分是贵族。
de: After being crowned king of Sweden, Christian II gave the order to execute nearly 100 people, mostly noblemen, despite promises of general amnesty.

t: 50多人在斯德哥尔摩血盆被判决并被处决.
te: More than 50 people are sentenced and executed in the Stockholm Bloodbath.
dz: 50多人在斯德哥尔摩血盆被判决并被处决.
de: More than 50 people are sentenced and executed in the Stockholm Bloodbath.

t: 38天后，斐迪南·麦哲伦指挥的探险队首次穿越麦哲伦海峡，进入太平洋。
te: After 38 days, an expedition under the command of Ferdinand Magellan completes the first passage through the Strait of …
dz: 38天后，斐迪南·麦哲伦指挥的探险队首次穿越麦哲伦海峡，进入太平洋。
de: After 38 days, an expedition under the command of Ferdinand Magellan completes the first passage through the Strait of Magellan and enters the Pacific Ocean.

t: 马丁路德在维滕贝格的埃尔斯特门外烧毁了他的教皇诏书 Exsurge Domine 的副本。
te: Martin Luther burns his copy of the papal bull Exsurge Domine outside Wittenberg's Elster Gate.
dz: 马丁路德在维滕贝格的埃尔斯特门外烧毁了他的教皇诏书 Exsurge Domine 的副本。
de: Martin Luther burns his copy of the papal bull Exsurge Domine outside Wittenberg's Elster Gate.
